items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Amanda Randolph, she worked there with me, fellow named Mope

ctx.x: Yeah. And you know who worked there? When Gladys left and went to -- I think she went to California -- Amanda Randolph, she worked there with me, fellow named Mope and the pianist -- what was his name? I can't remember that.
It wasn't -- there was a place called the Zambezi.
